dataset.name: de Buhr & Gräter, Data from: Myristoyl's dual role in allosterically regulating and localizing Abl kinase
dataset.type: MD simulation inputs, analysis outputs and backbone/protein trajectories (GROMACS)
dataset.description: Equilibrium MD of Abl kinase-only and SH3-SH2-kinase models with and without myristoyl (Myr); metadynamics; umbrella sampling; FDA; PCA

source.primary_reference: de Buhr S, Gräter F. Myristoyl's dual role in allosterically regulating and localizing Abl kinase. eLife 12:RP85216 (2023), PMC10619977

redistribution_of_derived_files.evidence: CC0-1.0 public-domain dedication (Dryad record); citation is good practice

size_and_download.approval_required: no trajectory or archive was downloaded; the frozen ABL-MYR-1 budget is ≤ 1.2 GB download, ≤ 4 GB storage, ≤ 2 CPU-h

size_and_download.access_mechanism_observed: 2026-10-24: /api/v2/files/<id>/download returns HTTP 401 'must have current bearer token'; /downloads/file_stream/<id> serves an 'Anubis' proof-of-work bot challenge page. Neither was bypassed.

independence.prior_topofold_use: none; not previously seen or used by TopoFold
independence.overlap_with_other_datasets: Abl kinase domain also in KIN-DESC-1 (crystal chains 1OPJ, 1OPK, 2F4J) and the ABL/Ayaz route; different structures, force field (CHARMM36m vs a99SB-disp), isoform numbering (1b vs 1a) and question
independence.labels_from_topofold_output: no labels used; the comparison is descriptive and has no external endpoint
independence.equal_information_constraints: TopoFold κ/τ and the Cα baselines receive the same Cα frames of the same runs; φ/ψ (backbone N, C) is a separately labelled stronger-information comparator

endpoint.measurement: none for the ABL-MYR-1 comparison (simulation-only, descriptive)
endpoint.processed_values_available: the authors' own analyses (RMSD, RMSF, helicity, PCA projections, p-values) are included but are not used as labels
condition_mismatches_with_simulation: question is myristoyl/allostery in a modelled isoform-1b kinase domain with ATP/Mg2+; it is unrelated to the Ayaz M472I/imatinib-resistance question and to the Ayaz HDX endpoint

runs_per_condition.each model: 20 = Set1 replicates 11-20 (v-rescale thermostat) + Set2 replicates 21-30 (Nosé–Hoover); README and eLife Methods

replicates.run_lengths: 2000 ns each; the authors exclude the first 1000 ns from analysis (eLife Methods)
replicates.frame_interval: PCA.zip traj_{model}_{rep}.xtc: kinase-domain backbone, one frame per 2 ns; FDA.zip: protein atoms, 200 ps, first 1000 ns excluded (README)
replicates.run_independence: same modelled start per model and set; replicate start method not stated (to be read from the .tpr/.mdp at gate G4)
replicates.temporal_dependence_notes: the authors report PC1 autocorrelation low after 100 ns and close to zero after 500 ns (eLife Figure 2—figure supplement 3C); runs, not frames, are the replicates

mapping.reference_numbering: UniProt P00519-2 (isoform IB, 1149 aa); the paper uses isoform 1b numbering; 1b = 1a + 19 across the kinase domain (verified: K290, E305, H380-R381-D382, D400-F401-G402, M491; I521, V525, L529)
mapping.method: topofold_inputs.kinase_roles alignment of the trajectory topology to P00519-2 with an explicit reference numbering (gate G3)
mapping.chain_rule: the single protein chain of the PCA reference topology
mapping.atoms_available: PCA.zip: backbone of the kinase domain (topology file KD_noIa_bb_ref.pdb; whether αI is included is unverified)
mapping.atoms_needed: Cα for κ/τ and the Cα baselines; backbone N, Cα, C for the φ/ψ comparator

missing_data_and_exclusions.unobserved: unknown until the topology is read

reasons: a matched, replicated two-condition subset is documented (kinase_kinked_Myr vs kinase_kinked_noMyr, 10 + 10 runs per thermostat set)
backbone XTC trajectories readable by the existing MDAnalysis adapter are documented in PCA.zip
open_conditions: owner decision on a dated ABL-MYR-1 amendment for the missing Set2/system.gro (see benchmarks/audit/abl_myr_1/README.md)

notes: Model archives (kinase_*.zip, SH3-SH2-KD_*.zip) contain simulation inputs (.mdp, .top/.itp, .gro starting structures, .tpr) and analysis outputs (.xvg, .dat); no trajectory files are listed in them (README directory tree).

Figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.4496795 (CC BY 4.0): one 1-µs run of ABL1 242-493 (AMBER99SB-ILDN, 300 K, 250-ps frames, 4000 snapshots) in MDTraj HDF5 (141,949,663 B). Usable only for a loader check, never as replicated evidence; not downloaded, because reading it needs a new HDF5/MDTraj path that the Dryad XTC route does not use.

2026-10-24 (D58): the published model archives list system.gro for Set1 but not for Set2 (README tree and archive listings agree); the ABL-MYR-1 spec required it in both sets.
